subject.title: 飞书消息回复引用(replyTo)有时不显示 - OpenClaw 2026.3.23-2

question: Should maintainers repair/adopt https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/78964 for this Feishu reply-anchor cluster, or close/replace it with a narrower explicit `replyTo` fix?
rationale: The code gap is narrow, but an overlapping proof-supplied PR already changes the same Feishu routing surfaces and is currently conflicting with prior P1 routing findings.

options.title: Repair/adopt the existing PR
options.body: Rebase and fix the open Feishu anchor PR so it preserves current normal-group and P2P invariants while adding the missing ordinary-send `replyTo` behavior.

options.title: Open a narrower replacement
options.body: If the current branch is too broad, close or supersede it with a credited replacement that only fixes explicit send `replyTo` plus the required regression and live proof.

options.title: Split final-reply work separately
options.body: Keep `dispatch complete ... replies=0` under the newer final-reply issue and use this issue only for Feishu reply-anchor delivery.

recommendation.title: Repair/adopt the existing PR
recommendation.body: Rebase and fix the open Feishu anchor PR so it preserves current normal-group and P2P invariants while adding the missing ordinary-send `replyTo` behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They have recent merged work in the Feishu action/media/card path and member-authored Feishu PR history around this surface.
